notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes list Joni Eastley / Jim Butler Days and include 'possibly for next year.' Gmail history confirms Joni said it was too late for 2026 and budget was an issue; Adventure Zone explicitly left the door open for 2027. Source: handwritten call notes, page 117; Adventure Zone Gmail.

followUps.label: 2027 booking follow-up
followUps.reason: Joni indicated 2026 was too late and budget was a concern, but 2027 remained open. Reach out well before Memorial Day planning is finalized.
